summary.key_theme: 儘管近期面臨獲利了結與監管疑慮導致股價波動，但市場仍高度看好 Bloom Energy 作為 AI 基礎設施關鍵供應商的長期成長潛力與技術優勢。

bullish.title: BE Stock Recovers After Monday Slide On Analyst Support: Peers FCEL, PLUG Edge Higher
bullish.reason: Jefferies 將目標價從 229 美元上調至 264 美元，顯示專業機構對其長期價值與市場地位的認可，有效支撐股價反彈。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy (NYSE:BE) Stock Screens Well on High Growth and Improving Fundamentals
bullish.reason: 透過成長性篩選模型，確認公司在營收、利潤率與現金流方面表現強勁，基本面支撐其高估值。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy: The Power Bottleneck Was Just The Beginning
bullish.reason: 公司推出 800V DC 架構，精準對接下一代 AI 資料中心對高效能電力的需求，強化其競爭護城河。

bullish.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Nvidia, Bloom Energy and Amphenol
bullish.reason: 被列為 AI 基礎設施核心標的，受益於整體產業需求強勁與獲利動能，吸引市場資金關注。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy Is Up More Than 200% So Far This Year. What Comes Next for BE Stock.
bullish.reason: 報導 Fremont 新廠房建設，顯示公司積極擴產以應對訂單需求，為長期成長提供實體產能支持。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy (BE) Stock Still Looks Undervalued After a 24x Run
bullish.reason: 儘管股價已大幅上漲，分析指出其估值仍具吸引力，鼓勵投資人持續關注其成長軌跡。

bearish.title: What's Going On With Bloom Energy Stock Monday?
bearish.reason: 股價單日重挫 9%，主要受 Oracle Project Jupiter 專案不確定性、潛在訴訟風險及獲利了結賣壓影響。

bearish.title: Why Bloom Energy (BE) Shares Are Sliding Today
bearish.reason: 彙整了股價下跌的市場情緒，反映出投資人對高估值股票在面臨負面消息時的脆弱性。

bearish.title: Bloom Energy (BE) Sees a More Significant Dip Than Broader Market: Some Facts to Know
bearish.reason: 強調股價跌幅大於大盤，顯示短期內市場對該個股的拋售壓力較大。

bearish.title: Can the AI Power Boom Justify Bloom Energy’s (BE) $85 Billion Valuation?
bearish.reason: 質疑 850 億美元估值的合理性，提醒投資人需關注 AI 需求是否能持續轉化為實際獲利。

neutral.title: Should Bloom Energy Stock Investors Worry About Its Record Quarter?
neutral.reason: 分析第二季財報結構，指出 90% 營收來自設備銷售，雖顯示強勁需求，但也引發對營收多元化的討論。

neutral.title: BE Stock Slumps Most In Over A Month: This Analyst Says New Fremont Facility Is An Indicator Of Strong Demand
neutral.reason: RBC Capital 維持 Outperform 評級與 335 美元目標價，雖為利多，但因與股價下跌同時發生，呈現多空拉鋸。
